rationale: A common request for post-action notification must wait for walking Evidence and then return through Planner-owned communication.

primary_outcomes: Walk forward for three seconds and report completion only after trusted execution Evidence confirms completion.
acceptable_auxiliary: Chromie may acknowledge the request before execution without claiming it is already complete.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Claim that walking is complete before provider Evidence exists.
Complete the body action without the requested post-completion communication.
Replay the walking action during evidence re-entry.

text: 往前走三秒，走完告诉我一声。
description: Execution completion must return to the same Planner-owned interaction.

memberships.title: Continuous Cognition and Recovery
memberships.general_rule: Meaningful runtime Evidence or provider-state change may reactivate the same Planner without fabricating a user turn, replaying completed work, or letting stale request/Plan provenance regain authority.
